summary: Iteration 138: tested invoice archiving on move-out, the per-tenant archive, permanent delete and reactivation (backend pytest + kiosk UI at 1920px). Most requested flows PASS. (1) Move-out with rent 2000, borg 1000 and 3 open invoices (aug/sep plus the auto-created okt) leaves every invoice with status 'archived' and archived=true. The first invoice keeps paid_amount 1000 and status_before_archive 'partial'. None of them appear in GET /api/invoices, /api/invoices/grouped (open/paid/all) or the kiosk Facturen modal (Alle/Achterstand/Betaald). (2) Archive UI: the Archief pill shows a count (2), archived-toggle shows archived-invoices with rows 'Open SRD 2.000,00 / 2.000,00 / 1.000,00', and archived-due shows 'Nog te betalen: SRD 5.000,00'. (3) Delete: archived-delete opens a native confirm with the correct text. After accepting, the row disappears. DB: tenant, invoices, contracts, deposits and payment_plans are all 0. The borgverrekening payment is kept with tenant_id '' and tenant_deleted true. GET /api/payments returns 200 and /api/kasgeld returns 200 and includes the payment. (4) DELETE permanent on an active tenant returns 404, as boekhouder returns 403, and a second delete returns 404. (5) Reactivation keeps the invoices out of /api/invoices and /grouped. (6) Regression: Huurders > detail > Uitgang starten in the kiosk works end to end (receipt 'Te betalen SRD 5.000,00', archived note, invoices archived). Three bugs FOUND, see the issues list.

critical.endpoint: POST /api/payments (and the other payment flows that pick the 'oldest open invoice' with status != 'paid': approve payment ~L6744/L9482, create payment ~L8991, recompute-invoices ~L9896)
critical.issue: After a tenant is reactivated, a new rent payment (FIFO, no invoice_ids) is booked on an ARCHIVED invoice (status 'archived' is not 'paid', so it matches). Reproduced: payment.invoice_id was the archived aug invoice. Archived invoices must be excluded (add archived: {$ne: true}) in every invoice lookup that uses status {$ne: 'paid'}.

Payments that are kept after a permanent delete (tenant_id '') are silently dropped: '[payments] SKIPPED corrupt doc (no tenant_id)' in the backend log. They vanish from the Betalingen list and from the /payments/paged month list and monthSum, but count_documents totalCount still counts them. Kasgeld still shows them. Allow tenant_id '' when tenant_deleted is true (for example tenant_name 'Verwijderde huurder').

minor.endpoint: GET /api/kiosk/tenants/{id}/overview (~L10287), tenant-portal overview fines (~L6478), _enrich_payments_bulk outstanding ($nin paid/cancelled)
minor.issue: For a reactivated tenant these queries filter only on status != 'paid', so the archived invoices are returned again. Reproduced: all 3 archived invoice ids appear in the kiosk overview response. As a result old debt and fines show up again in the kiosk and portal after reactivation, which goes against the requirement.

issues: Uses the native window.confirm instead of the app's styled confirm dialog (acceptable per the spec 'simple confirm', but it looks inconsistent with the rest of the app).

action_items: Exclude archived invoices (archived != true or status != 'archived') from every invoice query that uses status {$ne:'paid'}: payment create/approve FIFO matching, recompute-invoices, the kiosk tenant overview, tenant-portal fines, and outstanding in _enrich_payments_bulk. Otherwise payments of reactivated tenants are allocated to archived invoices and old debt reappears.
_enrich_payments_bulk: do not skip payments that have tenant_deleted=true and tenant_id '' (the Betalingen list currently loses them). Keep the list totals consistent with totalCount.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_archived_tenant also sets invoice_id None / invoice_ids [] on payments. The 'allocations' array still references deleted invoice ids (harmless, but it leaves stale references).
The startup migration runs every boot over all archived tenants. It is idempotent, but it does not use a company scope or batching. That is OK for now.
server.py is more than 19k lines and should be split into routers.

success_rate.backend: 75% (9/12 tests pass; 3 failing = the bugs above)

Everything was removed with cleanup_iter138.py, and the orphan test payments (tenant_deleted) were deleted directly in the DB. The seeded archived tenant 'Jan Pieterse' was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest tests/test_archive_invoices_iter138.py` (it self-cleans; tests 06, 07 and 13 should pass after the fixes), then `python tests/cleanup_iter138.py`. Payments left with tenant_deleted=true have to be removed from the DB directly. Kiosk access: admin-to-kiosk token in localStorage, then kiosk-admin-menu-btn -> kiosk-admin-menu-huurders -> tenant-filter-archived. Server date is 2026-10-25, and a deposit auto-creates the current-month invoice.
rca of the issue: Archiving changes status to 'archived' but does not set it to 'paid'. Many legacy queries treat anything with status != 'paid' as open, so archived invoices come back once the tenant is active again. The permanent delete sets tenant_id to '', and _enrich_payments_bulk has a legacy guard that skips docs without a tenant_id.
